sourceSnapshotStatement: API guide describes an April 2022 ENSDF snapshot. Per-line evaluation publication cutoff and actual extraction date are retained; extraction date is NOT an evaluation date. No assertion of latest ENSDF.
dataLicense: Source terms and attribution apply; data are excluded from the software MIT license. No IAEA or NNDC endorsement.
coverage: Selected nuclear gamma transitions for 11 parent states; not a complete nuclide library. X rays and annihilation radiation excluded.
